items.title: 11.11 Organic redox reactions (organic compounds mein oxidation aur reduction) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 11.11, printed page 268.

blocks.text: Woh oxidation-reduction reactions jin mein organic compounds hissa lete hain, organic redox reactions kehlati hain. In reactions ki pehchan atoms ya bonds ka jurna ya hatna hai. Aam taur par organic oxidation mein oxygen jurti hai ya hydrogen hat-ti hai. Organic reduction mein hydrogen jurti hai ya oxygen hat-ti hai. Oxidation aur reduction ki kuch misalein neeche di gayi hain.

blocks.caption: Organic redox pehchanna
rows: ethanol se ethanoic acid; ethane ka jalna
ethene se ethane; ethanal se ethanol

blocks.prompt: Har reaction ko oxidation ya reduction batayein: CH₃CH=CH₂ + H₂ → CH₃CH₂CH₃; CH₃CH₂OH → CH₃CHO; alkene ki ozonolysis.
blocks.explanation: Propene ki hydrogenation mein hydrogen jurti hai: reduction. Ethanol se ethanal mein do hydrogen hat-te hain: oxidation. Ozonolysis mein oxygen jurti hai aur C=C toot kar carbonyl compounds bante hain: oxidation.

items: Organic oxidation: O jure ya H hate; organic reduction: H jure ya O hate.
